statement.zh-TW: 能認出 TR、Profit、A、E 四個基本數字各來自哪張報表，說明營收是本期認列（賣出）的生意而不是收到的現金，並在計算時讓分子與分母用同一期間
statement.en: Recognise which statement each of the four basic figures TR, Profit, A and E comes from, explain that revenue is the sales recognised (goods sold) this period rather than the cash received, and keep numerator and denominator to the same period when calculating

text.zh-TW: 把營業收入當成這一期收到的現金
text.en: Treating revenue as the cash received this period

text.zh-TW: 以為 Profit 指的是營業毛利
text.en: Thinking Profit means gross profit

text.zh-TW: 以為資產總計是損益表上一段期間的數字
text.en: Thinking total assets is a period figure from the income statement

text.zh-TW: 以為 E 就等於股本
text.en: Thinking E is just share capital

text.zh-TW: 計算比率時分子與分母用不同的期間（例如一個月的營收對年底的資產）
text.en: Using different periods for numerator and denominator (for example one month of revenue against a year-end asset figure)

text.zh-TW: 以為營收和資產一樣，是某一天擁有多少的存量
text.en: Thinking revenue, like assets, is an amount held on one day

statement.zh-TW: 能用指定的版本計算純益率、資產週轉率，以及權益倍數與 ROE，並用三個因子相乘拆解 ROE
statement.en: Calculate net profit margin, asset turnover, the equity multiplier and ROE using the specified version, and split ROE into the product of the three factors

text.zh-TW: 算 ROE 時把分母用成資產總計
text.en: Using total assets as the denominator when calculating ROE

text.zh-TW: 把 ROA 或 ROE 的分子用成營業收入
text.en: Using revenue as the numerator of ROA or ROE

text.zh-TW: 把資產週轉率當成百分比，或把三個因子相加而不是相乘
text.en: Treating asset turnover as a percentage, or adding the three factors instead of multiplying them

statement.zh-TW: 能說明 ROE 與 ROA 的差距來自權益倍數（借來的錢），並分辨權益倍數與負債比率各回答什麼問題
statement.en: Explain that the gap between ROE and ROA comes from the equity multiplier (borrowed money), and tell apart the questions the equity multiplier and the debt ratio each answer

text.zh-TW: 看到 ROE 高就以為本業特別會賺錢
text.en: Assuming a high ROE means the core business is especially profitable

text.zh-TW: 以為「資產有多大比例來自負債」要看權益倍數
text.en: Thinking the equity multiplier answers ‘what share of assets is funded by liabilities’

text.zh-TW: 以為權益倍數越高越安全
text.en: Thinking a higher equity multiplier means a safer company

text.zh-TW: 搞錯權益倍數和負債多寡的關係（倍數一倍其實是沒有負債，大於一才表示有負債）
text.en: Getting the link between the equity multiplier and liabilities wrong (a multiplier of one actually means no liabilities; above one means there are some)

text.zh-TW: 以為請股東再增資一定能提高 ROE
text.en: Thinking that asking shareholders for more capital must raise ROE

text.zh-TW: 以為「資產有多大比例來自負債」要用負債除以權益
text.en: Thinking ‘what share of assets comes from liabilities’ is liabilities divided by equity

statement.zh-TW: 能說出人均營收與研發、資本支出、行銷相關的指標各衡量什麼、分子分母是什麼，並把指標放進正確的類別
statement.en: Say what revenue per employee and the research, capital spending and marketing indicators each measure and what their numerators and denominators are, and place indicators in the right category

text.zh-TW: 以為人均營收高就代表公司有賺錢
text.en: Assuming high revenue per employee means the company is profitable

text.zh-TW: 以為 RD intensity 越低越好
text.en: Thinking a lower R&D intensity is always better

text.zh-TW: 以為 CE intensity 與 CE turnover 提供不同的資訊
text.en: Thinking capex intensity and capex turnover give different information

text.zh-TW: 把行銷費用當成營業成本的一部分
text.en: Treating marketing expenses as part of cost of sales

statement.zh-TW: 能在幾個都合理的經營方案之間，用純益率、週轉率與權益倍數說明取捨的依據
statement.en: Between several reasonable business options, explain the trade-off using net profit margin, turnover and the equity multiplier

text.zh-TW: 以為提高 ROE 只有一種正確的做法
text.en: Thinking there is only one correct way to raise ROE

text.zh-TW: 以為提高 ROE 不需要付出任何代價
text.en: Thinking ROE can be raised at no cost
